bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
if docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | cut -d= -f1 | grep -Eq '^(TELEGRAM_TEST_BOT_TOKEN_FILE|VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TEST_TOKEN_FILE|VIDEOBOT_TEST_BOT_TOKEN_FILE)$'; then exit 0; fi
if docker exec "$cid" test -r /run/secrets/videobot_telegram_test_token; then exit 0; fi
exit 71
